name: Wikimedia Photos
description: Place photos from Wikimedia Commons (geo-search and tag-based lookup)

dataSources.purpose: Openly-licensed photographs near a place or from its Wikimedia Commons category
dataSources.dataSent: Coordinates (latitude, longitude) with 500 m radius for geo-search; Wikimedia Commons filename or category name (from OSM wikimedia_commons tag) for tag-based lookup
dataSources.dataReceived: File pages with thumbnail URL (800px), artist, license, capture date, coordinates. Geo-search filtered: no SVG/PDF/TIFF, max 50 MB. Tag-based: up to 6 files per category.
